evidence.title: Shadcn Icon Picker - Beautiful Icon Selection Component

name: Icon Picker
summary: Icon picker component for React that searches and picks from the Lucide icon set.
description: A component that lets users pick an icon from the Lucide icon list, with search, category shortcuts and a virtualized list. Props cover controlled and default value, a custom trigger, a custom icon list, modal mode and search behaviour.
contains: icon picker for React using all Lucide icons
searchable icon list with category buttons, virtualized with TanStack Virtual
props: controlled value, custom trigger, custom icons list, modal mode
